verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents PlayCanvas's physics only via rigidbody/collision/joint components powered by ammo.js (a 3D physics engine) and highlights Gaussian Splatting as a flagship 3D feature, but contains no mention of sprites, tilemaps, or a 2D physics system anywhere in the docs, GitHub excerpts, or community commentary. Since a game engine could plausibly offer first-class 2D tooling, the axis applies, but there is no evidence PlayCanvas delivers it.
